question: does 768-dim unprojected beat 512-dim projected for patch matching
design: paired: identical splits, shot counts and backbone; only the projection differs. Three seeds (42, 1, 2) x 15 categories.
notes: An earlier single-seed estimate gave +0.014 at 1-shot; with three seeds the effect is +0.026, so seed 42 understated it.

Marginal seed-to-seed std at 1-shot is 0.027, larger than the effect. That does not invalidate it: the comparison is paired, so split luck cancels and the relevant spread is the paired standard error (0.006).
